**Daily Devotional**

**June 9**

*14 And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth. (John 1:14 KJV)*

Jesus is the Word (John 1:1). It is so true that the Word was made flesh, as the words spoken by all the prophets for 2,000 years, prophesying the virgin birth of Jesus, were all put together to provide the seed needed to impregnate Mary with the seed of Jesus (Luke 1:35). That is why it took so long for God to bring Jesus into this world, as He had given mankind the dominion of this physical world (Genesis 1:26), and so He had to speak all the words necessary through man, before He could have the words necessary to impregnate Mary. The reason it took so long was because God could not find enough prophets on earth to say all the necessary things that had to be said to bring Jesus into being.

Can you imagine how hard it was for the old time prophets to say that Jesus would be born of a virgin (Isaiah 7:14), and then be crucified on the cross for our sins. No one prophet could believe God enough to say it all, so it took many prophets, and many years, to get all the words spoken that God needed to have man speak, before He could bring Jesus into being. It is so awesome to know that God would become a man, and die to pay for our sins, not because we deserve it, but just because He is love (1 John 4:8). Thank you Lord for our salvation.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
